purpose: Distinguish equal-budget early CEM distribution anchoring from late teacher candidate re-scoring on the exact 50-task dataset evaluation used in the valid preceding comparison.

hypotheses.early_distribution_anchoring: If teacher rounds 1-7 outperform teacher rounds 24-30 at equal per-batch teacher budget, early teacher updates likely anchor the CEM action distribution before student-driven updates can move it toward poor regions.
hypotheses.late_candidate_rescoring: If teacher rounds 24-30 outperform teacher rounds 1-7 at equal per-batch teacher budget, late teacher evaluation likely corrects candidate ranking near the final CEM updates.
hypotheses.interpretation_limit: A phase contrast identifies which placement of seven teacher-scored CEM rounds is more useful under this evaluator; scalar CEM mean/variance traces are secondary evidence and do not alone prove a causal internal mechanism.

task_and_protocol.row_order: Reuse selected_tasks.json exactly, without resampling, filtering, reordering, or outcome-based selection.
task_and_protocol.preprocessing: Reuse the successful baseline full-dataset action/proprio/state StandardScaler fits, NaN-row exclusions, goal-scaler reuse, and ImageNet/Resize224 pixel and goal transforms.
task_and_protocol.world_evaluator: Pinned World.evaluate dataset mode with the baseline callables, goal_offset_steps=25, eval_budget=50, world.max_episode_steps=100, video=None. This is dataset-protocol-aligned evaluation, not a verbatim upstream eval.py run or random-reset benchmark.
task_and_protocol.solver: Pinned CEMSolver; batch_size=1, num_samples=300, n_steps=30, topk=30, var_scale=1, CUDA; native torch.Generator seed 42 for each arm; no per-call reseeding.
task_and_protocol.batch_boundary: At each pinned CEMSolver callback start_batch (one environment chunk), reset the local route round counter. Apply and validate the chosen 1-indexed teacher rounds separately in every batch; preserve solve-wide teacher-call records.
task_and_protocol.distribution_trace: At post-update CEM rounds 1, 7, 8, 23, 24, and 30, store only mean RMS and mean variance scalars per batch. These are secondary descriptive metrics; do not retain candidate tensors, hash arrays, or add teacher/student cost calls.
task_and_protocol.source_provenance: Use the staged le-wm and stable-worldmodel source roots already validated by the preceding runs. Their staging paths and runtime import/API guards are provenance; do not claim a fresh checkout commit verification.

student_only.description: Student cost on every CEM round.

early_teacher7.description: Teacher cost on CEM rounds 1-7 of every start_batch; student cost on all other rounds.

late_teacher7.description: Teacher cost on CEM rounds 24-30 of every start_batch; student cost on all other rounds.

teacher_only.description: Teacher cost on every CEM round; exact vector reproduction reference.

run_order.algorithm: Python random.Random(seed).shuffle(arms), once before any dataset, checkpoint, or model loading.
run_order.unit: One complete vectorized 50-task arm evaluation; save the order before loading model weights.

primary_comparison.unit: Paired source episode; each of the 50 selected source episodes occurs once.
primary_comparison.test: Exact two-sided source-episode cluster sign-flip test; with one row per cluster this equals the exact paired McNemar test.

verdicts.early_anchor_favored: early_teacher7 - late_teacher7 >= 5 successes and exact p < 0.05.
verdicts.late_rescoring_favored: late_teacher7 - early_teacher7 >= 5 successes and exact p < 0.05.
verdicts.otherwise: INCONCLUSIVE; do not infer a preferred timing mechanism.

secondary_and_promotion_gates.comparisons_to_student: Report paired exact cluster tests for early7 vs student-only and late7 vs student-only as secondary checks; do not replace the primary early7-vs-late7 contrast.
secondary_and_promotion_gates.legacy_practical_gain: A phase-favored schedule is useful versus student only only if it adds at least 5/50 successes and its exact paired p < 0.05.
secondary_and_promotion_gates.legacy_teacher_gap: A phase-favored schedule must be within 5 successes of teacher-only to meet the carried-forward quality target.
secondary_and_promotion_gates.legacy_latency: Report synchronized planner solve time ratio phase-favored schedule / teacher-only; carried-forward target is <=0.70.
secondary_and_promotion_gates.overall_interpretation: Report phase mechanism verdict separately from usefulness/teacher-gap/latency. Passing a phase contrast alone does not promote the student or meet the previous engineering gate.

validity_gates: Exactly 50 source task keys reused unchanged for each of 4 arms; exactly 200 unique arm/task outcome keys and 50 rows per arm.
The source task list has 50 unique episode_idx values; all four arms preserve identical row_index, episode_idx, and start_step per task.
Teacher-only per-task success vector exactly matches baseline 25534994.pbs101; otherwise fail closed without resampling or rerunning.
All 6 prepared observation keys are exactly paired across arms.
Every CEM start_batch contains exactly 30 route evaluations; route flags and teacher-round lists match the frozen arm schedule exactly.
All outcomes, route finite flags, scalar traces, timings, and reported numerical metrics are finite.
CEM solver seed is 42 per arm; common solve-prefix generator states and candidate shapes match across arms.
PBS compute-node guards pass, all required artifacts are written, and no timeout or missing outcome occurs.
failure_rule: Any validity gate failure yields FAIL_CLOSED and no performance or mechanism conclusion. Preserve artifacts and do not change the 50 tasks or rerun under this freeze.

resources.gpu_telemetry: nvidia-smi utilization and memory sampled every 5 seconds to this job's job.log; terminate and wait for the monitor PID on exit.
resources.submission: One bounded PBS job after freeze, runner, and shell static checks pass.
